newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares slip, downward trend seen holding.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares slip, downward trend seen holding.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased on Monday, extending their losses to a third trading session on meagre turnover.
Traders blamed the inactivity to a stark absence of fresh buying incentives and said the blue-chip SBI index would likely continue falling over the medium term.
* The SBI index fell 0.43 percent or 5.62 points to 1,303.56.
* Issue A of drug maker Lek was the most active, firming 0.17 percent to 24,180 tolars on volume of 603 shares for total turnover of 14.6 million tolars..
* Preferred shares of Dolenjska bank led the day's decliner, falling 3.52 percent to 13,990 tolars on volume of 200. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
